notes: Upgraded from reproduced to verified (exact: true) in 0.5 s without floating-point arithmetic. The exact Z[i] codimension-2 Galois quotient on all 36,720 4-qubit stabilizer states enumerates all 9 exact rank-3 decompositions of |T>^4 (the full symmetry orbit of the QubitTM4 witness), and an exact integer check over all (4 * 2^4)^3 = 262,144 phased 4-qubit Pauli assignments proves that 0 of the 9 decompositions satisfy the slice-1 identity sum_{j=1}^3 d_j w_j = ratio_T * D * psi_4 over Q(i, sqrt(3)).
